profile.headline: Software Engineering
profile.summary: With 20+ years of experience in software development, I have successfully delivered complex enterprise solutions . I have extensive experience in developing enterprise solutions including eCommerce, consumer personalization, insurance, financial trading.

positions.title: Senior Manager Software Engineering
positions.description: Technical solution owner responsible for scaling and growing the capabilities of the Taco Bell's ecommerce platform.  Lead team of engineers comprising of front end, iOS, android, Hybris, and full stack developers.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect
positions.description: Responsible for architecting and implementation of Taco Bell's ecommerce platform.

positions.title: Solution Principal
positions.description: Coached a team of 5 full stack engineering consultants.  We specialized in open source technologies for developing rich web-based user experience, mobile solutions, and powerful lightweight APIs.  Clients include Taco Bell, PIMCO, Visa, American Home for Rent, and Fisker Automotive.

positions.title: Senior Technical Architect
positions.description: Lead team of developers and application architects to implement the company’s core Billing, Underwriting, Claims, and online insurance quote/buy application.

positions.title: Founding Engineer/Product Development Manager
positions.description: Lead the design and implementation of the Siperian Activity Server (SAS), which harvests, caches, reconcile, cleanse, and synchronizes operational and analytical customer information among disparate systems into an Object Data Store.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Trained and certified as a system integrator consultant for Kana Software CRM.  Clients included: Radiant Logic, Go America, BigWords.com, CarParts.com

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: A founding engineer of a startup company set out to implement a customer profiling platform (pre-dating web analytics).  The platform leverages server side action (click) tracking and a robust homegrown Rete rules engine to profile and segment customers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: A startup company focused on building a collaboration platform which includes multi-channel chat, instant messaging center, email, contact management, and schedule management.
